figures.title: Run all six beats; keep the verdict human
figures.desc: The exact six-beat half-day operator pulse, from the live Direction Brief through mission work, logging, adversarial review, measurement, and transfer.
figures.caption: Read left to right: measurement follows adversarial review; transfer follows measurement.
figures.transcript: One: Direction Brief in Operator — Direction & Log. Two: mission build in a build chat. Three: Operator Log plus PASS_BARS draft in Direction & Log. Four: adversarial review in a new chat every block. Five: Measurement Spine—ritual, mission, quality, and time. Six: Transfer pulse in Operator — Transfer 30-60-90.
